Answer: B
Reason: The chest X-ray shows a reticulo-nodular pattern predominantly in the right perihilar region and left mid zone (indicated by blue arrows), along with nodular opacities in the left upper zone and adjacent to the left costo-phrenic angle (indicated by the yellow circle). This bilateral, upper/mid-zone predominant distribution with peripheral nodules is consistent with the typical radiographic presentation of pulmonary sarcoidosis.
